plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so percentage work can start cleanly, and the main program begins in Week 2. With only one S&C day per week and a preference for more conditioning, each session prioritizes power first, then strength, then a small amount of practical accessory work and short fight-useful conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple explosive qualities while keeping conditioning support in place.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work with slightly higher intensity while controlling fatigue around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength topped up and express it through faster, sharper explosive work without forcing a speed peak.
